SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MAIN_MENU_TIP_NO_KEY:
Spire Mod Manager - View and manage your mods

SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.PENDING_RESTART: Mod changes will be applied after a restart
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.GO_TO_OURS: Go to Spire Mod Manager page
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.VANILLA_VIEW_TIP: View the game's vanilla Modding page.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.VANILLA_VIEW_SAME_ID: In vanilla, mods {mods} will be considered duplicate, and cannot be adjusted independently. These will use the Spire Mod Manager configuration as a fallback.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LOADS_FIRST_TIP: Spire Mod Manager always loads first, so it can configure the rest of the list properly.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ORDER_PROBLEMS: For compatibility, {count} mods will be automatically reordered by the base game on relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ORDER_PROBLEMS_ONE: For compatibility, 1 mod will be automatically reordered by the base game on relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DISABLE_ALL_KEEPS_SELF: Spire Mod Manager (this mod) will remain enabled
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_ON_TIP: {other} is already enabled. If both are enabled, only {loads} loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.BULK_ENABLES_COPIES_TI: Enables more than one copy of {mods}. Only one copy of each loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SELF_COPY_LOCKED_TIP: Spire Mod Manager is installed more than once, so its copies stay enabled. If one is removed, another still loads. To turn Spire Mod Manager off, disable them all on the vanilla Modding page.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SELF_COPY_LOCKED_OTHER: Spire Mod Manager stays enabled. {other} is disabled, so Spire Mod Manager won't load if this copy is removed. Enable it too.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SELF_COPY_OFF_TIP: Enable this copy too, so Spire Mod Manager still loads if the other copy is removed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_ENABLED_TIP: View all enabled, including enabled but pending
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_CHANGED_TIP: Show mods changed since launch: enabled or disabled, installed, moved, or edited
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_OFF: {count} enabled mods require a mod that is disabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_OFF_ONE: 1 enabled mod requires a mod that is disabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_MISSING: {count} enabled mods require a mod that isn't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LIST_PROBLEMS_MISSING_: 1 enabled mod requires a mod that isn't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_FILTER_TIP: Shows only these mods. The search box holds the filter. Press again to clear it.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHOW_FILTER_FIND_TIP: Finds these mods in the list. Press again to clear the search.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MANAGERS_WARNING: Multiple mod managers are currently enabled, and may cause unexpected behavior.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SAME_ID_WARNING: {count} mods with the same ID are enabled. Only one copy of each loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SELF_OFF: Spire Mod Manager (this mod) will be disabled on relaunch, and this menu will no longer be accessible until enabled again.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ENABLE_SELF_TIP: Keep Spire Mod Manager (this mod) enabled
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DISMISS_MANAGERS_TIP: Dismiss the warning. Will reappear if the problem is retriggered.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.RELAUNCH_CHECK_INTRO: These mods are enabled, but won't load:
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.RELAUNCH_CHECK_OK: Mods are now ready to be loaded.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_CATEGORY_BODY: [gold]{name}[/gold] contains {count} mods. They will move to Uncategorized.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_CATEGORY_BODY_O: [gold]{name}[/gold] contains 1 mod. It will move to Uncategorized.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_SUGGESTIONS_HEADIN: Currently used tags; Shift-click to add multiple
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAGS_BULK_ADD: Add tags to selected mods, comma-separated
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAGS_BULK_HINT: Some mods may already have existing tags that aren't displayed here. Anything entered here will be added to each mod without affecting the existing tags. If you remove a tag from this field, it will remove the tag on all the selected mods.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_HINT: Enter notes here to apply them to all selected mods. Note: mods with already existing notes will have them overwritten.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_MIXED: {count} mods have differing notes and will be overwritten!
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NOTES_BULK_MIXED_ONE: 1 mod has differing notes and will be overwritten!
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_GAMEPLAY_TIP: This mod affects gameplay. Multiplayer requires all players to have it installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_LIBRARY_TIP: This is a framework intended to be used by other mods; often has no effect when installed alone.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_LOCAL_TIP: This mod was installed locally and contains no Steam Workshop information.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_SAME_ID_TIP: Another copy of this mod is installed, with the same ID: {others}.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_SAME_ID_CLASH_TIP: Another copy of this mod is enabled: {others}. Only {loads} loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_NEW_TIP: This mod was recently added, and requires a relaunch to be loaded.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_COSMETIC_TIP: This mod changes game art, such as character and card reskins, backgrounds, battle animations, or sound effects and music.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_STABLE_TIP: This mod is listed for the stable branch (public) only. On beta, it loads with an error, and may not work.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.TAG_BETA_TIP: This mod is listed for the beta branch (public-beta) only. On stable, it loads with an error, and may not work.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.ALIAS_HINT: An alternative title for the mod
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.AUTHOR: Author
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOADS_AFTER: Loads on relaunch, in place of {other}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOSES: {other} loads instead. {why} Disable one to choose.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOSES_PLAIN: {other} loads instead. Disable one to choose.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_WHY_LOCAL: The game loads the local copy.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_WHY_HIGHER: The game loads the higher version.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_WHY_SOURCE: Only one copy from the same source loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_LOADS_ALSO: {other} is also enabled - this copy is the one that loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_FAILED_OTHER: {other} is also installed. To load that copy instead, enable it and disable this one.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_NOT_APPLIED: Spire Mod Manager couldn't choose which copy was loaded. If the game is on a different version, Spire Mod Manager may need to be updated.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_RUNS: This copy is running. {other} stays enabled too, in case this one is removed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_RUNS_SWITCH: This copy is running. After a relaunch, {other} loads instead. {why}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_RUNS_OTHER_O: This copy is running. {other} is disabled, so Spire Mod Manager won't load if this one is removed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_BACKUP: {other} is running. This copy stays enabled, in case that one is removed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_BACKUP_SWITC: {other} is running. After a relaunch, this copy loads instead. {why}
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.COPY_SELF_OFF: {other} is running. This copy is disabled, so Spire Mod Manager won't load if that one is removed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.OTHERS_PARKED: {count} more from other mods: see Vanilla List
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.GAME_CAPTION_OFF: Error while loading - Can be ignored if mod is disabled
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SEARCH_CLICK_TIP: Click: search this term; Shift-click: add to search
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.HOLD_ALT: Hold Alt to see the full text
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NO_CHANGES: No changes have been made since launching the game.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CHANGES_OPEN_HINT: Click mod name to view it
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_MOD_BODY: New mods were detected and will be loaded after a relaunch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_COPY_ON_BODY: A new copy of {mods} was installed and is enabled. Only {loads} loads. Disable the copy you don't want.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_COPIES_ON_BODY: New copies of {mods} were installed and are enabled. Only one copy of each loads. Disable the copies you don't want.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_COPY_OFF_BODY: A new copy of {mods} was installed and is disabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEW_SELF_COPY_BODY: A new copy of Spire Mod Manager (this mod) was installed. Its copies stay enabled, and only {loads} loads.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.LAUNCH_FAILED_TITLE: The last launch stopped before the main menu
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.CRASH_GAME_CHANGED: The game itself was updated since then, so the old setup may not start either.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_RECOVERED:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

Backup from {date} was loaded instead.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_FROM_BMM:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

No backup was found, so your groups, notes and profiles were imported again from Better Mod Menu.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_FRESH:
The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read.

No backup was found so an empty profile will be created.

The unreadable file can be found in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DATA_READ_ONLY:
Changes this session won't be saved.

The file with your categories, profiles and notes couldn't be read or moved.
If the file is currently in use by another program, that program may need to be closed.

You can find the file in the [url=folder]Spire Mod Manager's data folder[/url] as:
"{file}"

Relaunch the game and try again.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MOVE_HINT: Click to place · right-click or Esc to cancel
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.NEEDS_UPDATE: Spire Mod Manager is incompatible with this game version, or may require an update.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.DELETE_PROFILE_BODY:
Delete profile [gold]{name} ({mods})[/gold]?

All mods remain installed; only the saved selection goes.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SHARE_BODY:
Save to file or copy mod list for profile {name}. The text or file can be shared with others or yourself, and be imported in the profile selection menu.
Disabled mods (installed, but not active), aliases and notes aren't included by default.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_BODY: Load or paste a mod list to create a new profile. Configurations from Better Mod Menu, or other mods that use a similar CSV structure, may also be imported.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_EMPTY: Load or paste a mod list first
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_ID: This list is missing the Mod Id column, or in an incorrect format. The list must be in CSV format with the first line naming the columns, including Mod Id and Enabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_ENABLED: This list is missing the Enabled column, or in an incorrect format. The list must be in CSV format with the first line naming the columns, including Mod Id and Enabled.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_BAD_ENABLED: Enabled value for {mod} must be "TRUE", "FALSE" or blank. Current value "{value}" can not be parsed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_NO_MODS: This list has no mods in it.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_CHANGES: Changes compared to the current profile:
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_MISSING: Not installed ({count}). The missing mods will be saved in the profile and loaded once they are installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.IMPORT_BOTH_COPIES: You currently have a manual installation of one of the listed mods. Both copies will remain installed, but only one should be enabled to prevent issues.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_WARNING: This profile contains {count} mods that aren't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_WARNING_ONE: This profile contains 1 mod that isn't installed.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_SHOW_TIP: Show list of mods that need installing
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_DISABLE_TIP: Remove the missing mods saved to the profile, so they are no longer asked for. Undo to bring them back.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_DISMISS_TIP: Hide notice unless missing mods are loaded again
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_SEARCH_HINT: {count} mods in this profile aren't installed. [url=missing]Show them[/url]
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_SEARCH_HINT_ON: 1 mod in this profile isn't installed. [url=missing]Show it[/url]
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_BODY: This profile enables mods that aren't installed. Subscribe on the Workshop, or install them manually, and they will be loaded with the next launch.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.MISSING_BODY_NO_STEAM: This profile enables mods that aren't installed. To subscribe to them from here, the game must be running through Steam.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SUBSCRIBE_TIP: Subscribe and install from the Steam workshop
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SUBSCRIBE_FAILED_GONE: Couldn't find mod. The listing could be removed, or set to private.
SPIRE_MOD_MANAGER.SUBSCRIBE_FAILED_STEAM: Steam couldn't do it just now
